usage.summary:
Implemented the classification, replay contract, mandatory gate obligations, evidence views and docs. Formatting, vet, all 17 acceptance tests and new unit regressions pass.

**The build remains blocked:** seven protected tests require unclassified new proposals or old dashboard/receipt wording. Updating those fixtures and assertions requires expanding the ratified file scope; I left them untouched.

Graph cards use current per-project receipts because model graphs are shared. Pinned-TLC integration regressions were added but weren’t run offline. No pinned statements, locks or decision records changed.
